title: CDK-X Library
description: Scaffold a new @cdk-x/<name> jsii-enabled TypeScript library.

name.description: Short kebab-case library name (e.g. "widget"). Used for the packages/<name> directory and the @cdk-x/<name> npm package.
name.x-prompt: What is the short (kebab-case) name of the library?

languages.description: Additional jsii target languages to generate bindings for, beyond npm (always implicit).

x-prompt.message: Which additional jsii target languages should this library ship?

phase.description: Release phase recorded as a project.json tag (drives the version pre-id via tools/release.mjs), and mapped to package.json's jsii `stability` field: "stable" stays "stable", everything else becomes "experimental".

x-prompt.message: What release phase should this library start in?
